questions.questionText: Which company had the highest production in 2020?
questions.explanation: Compare the values for 2020: Kia India 475, Maruti Suzuki 270, Hyundai India 485, Tata Motors 430, Toyota Kirloskar 325, Honda Cars 495. The largest is 495, for Honda Cars.
questions.shortcut: Scan the single column or row once and keep only the current maximum in mind.

questions.questionText: In which year was the production for Kia India the lowest?
questions.explanation: Values for Kia India: 2019 645, 2020 475, 2021 740, 2022 430. The smallest is 430, in 2022.
questions.shortcut: Look for the smallest number in the row; ignore everything else.

questions.questionText: What is the sum of the production for Toyota Kirloskar in 2020 and the production for Tata Motors in 2022?
questions.explanation: Toyota Kirloskar in 2020 = 325; Tata Motors in 2022 = 620. Sum = 945.
questions.shortcut: Write both cell values down first, then add; the trap options use the wrong period for one of them.

questions.questionText: In how many years did the production for Maruti Suzuki exceed 247 thousand units?
questions.explanation: Values for Maruti Suzuki: 220, 270, 285, 225. Those above 247: 2020 (270), 2021 (285), i.e. 2.
questions.shortcut: Tick every cell larger than the benchmark and count the ticks.

questions.questionText: What is the difference between the highest and the lowest combined production of all the companies in a single year?
questions.shortcut: Find the two extreme column totals only; there is no need to compute any other difference.

questions.questionText: What was the rainfall for Chennai in July?
questions.explanation: Locate Chennai and July in the table. The entry where they meet is 220 mm.
questions.shortcut: Run a finger along the row of the entity and the column of the period; check you have not slid to a neighbouring cell.

questions.questionText: By how much is the total rainfall of Chennai in the first two months of the table different from the total rainfall of Lucknow in the last two months of the table?
questions.explanation: Chennai, first two: 220 + 250 = 470. Lucknow, last two: 345 + 290 = 635. Difference = 165.
questions.shortcut: Compute the two small sums separately and subtract; do not subtract cell by cell.

questions.questionText: In how many months did the rainfall for Bengaluru exceed 160 mm?

questions.questionText: What is the sum of the rainfall for Bengaluru in July and the rainfall for Lucknow in September?

questions.questionText: By how much did the rainfall for Chennai exceed that for Bengaluru in July?
questions.explanation: Chennai in July = 220 and Bengaluru in July = 155. Difference = 220 - 155 = 65.
questions.shortcut: Subtract only the two cells in the same column; do not mix periods.
